event_summary.short: Couple goes nuts after traffic stop for suspended plates, leading to arrests and charges.

evidence.quote: male suspect Luther was charged with operating a suspended registration
female suspect Amanda was charged with two counts of felony aggravated battery on a peace officer, resisting, and domestic battery with physical contact

He entered no plea and was found guilty. He was ordered to pay $390 and 20 cents... She took a plea deal, pleading guilty to the resisting charge... sentenced to two years of probation, ordered to perform 100 hours of public service, and ordered to enroll in a partner abuse intervention program.
